oral_examination.oral_examination: The oral hygiene of the entire mouth was poor, with tartar, soft plaque, and pigment, the gums were obviously red and swollen, bleeding at the gum margin was not reached, and the periodontal pockets were not reached, and the teeth were not obviously loose. 46 The gums on the lingual side are swollen and hemispherical, and they easily bleed and overflow when touched.

treatment_plan.definitive: Full mouth ultrasonic supragingival scaling. 46Elective subgingival scaling

source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Full mouth ultrasonic supragingival scaling, polishing and medication. OHI oral hygiene education, education on brushing teeth, flossing, and using interstitial brushes.
